import copy
import importlib.util
import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.').resolve()
records=json.loads((root/'tests/evidence/t13-11-repeat.json').read_text())
plan=root/'tests/evidence/t13-11-plan.json'
comparator=root/'tests/evidence/compare_consistency.py'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('validator', root/'tests/evidence/validate_evidence.py')
validator=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(validator)
checks=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 d=Path(d)
 varied=copy.deepcopy(records); next(r for r in varied if r['case_id']=='TC-60' and r['consistency']['repeat_index']==2)['observations']['tone']='Yellow'
 p=d/'varied.json'; p.write_text(json.dumps(varied)); result=subprocess.run(['python3',str(comparator),str(plan),str(p)],capture_output=True)
 if result.returncode==0: raise AssertionError('accepted variation')
 checks.append('REJECTED: material observation variation')
 missing=records[:-1]; p=d/'missing.json'; p.write_text(json.dumps(missing)); result=subprocess.run(['python3',str(comparator),str(plan),str(p)],capture_output=True)
 if result.returncode==0: raise AssertionError('accepted missing repeat')
 checks.append('REJECTED: missing planned repeat')
 duplicate=copy.deepcopy(records); selected=[r for r in duplicate if r['case_id']=='TC-60']; selected[1]['consistency']['evaluator_context_id']=selected[0]['consistency']['evaluator_context_id']
 try: validator.validate_repeat_plan(duplicate,plan)
 except ValueError: checks.append('REJECTED: reused evaluator context')
 else: raise AssertionError('accepted reused context')
print('\n'.join(checks)); print('negative consistency-gate checks: 3 passed')
